target.title: fix(docker): bound smoke installer curl with connect timeout
target.body:
AI-assisted: yes. I reviewed and understand the change.

## What Problem This Solves

The install-sh-smoke Docker runner executes a direct `curl | bash` one-liner (line 338) with no connect or transfer timeout. The `run_installer_for_package_spec` function and the freshness path both use the shared `run_installer_for_package_spec` wrapper which is already bounded by `timeout --kill-after=30s "${INSTALL_COMMAND_TIMEOUT}s"`. The direct one-liner was the only unprotected path.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add `--connect-timeout 30` and `--max-time 300` to the direct installer one-liner curl. The 30 s connection timeout catches stalled TLS handshakes early; the 300 s transfer timeout is well below the harness's 2700 s container timeout while remaining generous for installer downloads. The curl-level timeout is **complementary** to the configurable `INSTALL_COMMAND_TIMEOUT` — it bounds the network transfer specifically, while the process-level timeout bounds the entire install command including the subsequent bash execution.

## User Impact

Smoke test CI jobs now fail within a bounded interval when the installer CDN stalls, instead of hanging until the outer CI timeout.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/test-install-sh-docker.test.ts --run -t "runs candidate tarballs"`: passed.
- The existing test assertion was extended to verify the exact `--connect-timeout 30 --max-time 300` flags.
- `git diff --check`: passed.

### Real behavior proof (controlled curl stall)

Healthy path — a normal HTTPS request completes within the timeout:

```
$ curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 300 -o /dev/null   -w 'HTTP %{http_code}, time_total: %{time_total}s'   https://openclaw.bot/install.sh
HTTP 200, time_total: 0.8s
```

Stalled path — connecting to a non-routable address exits within the connect-timeout bound:

```
$ curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 10 -o /dev/null 'https://10.255.255.1:9999/'
curl: (28) Connection timed out after 3013 milliseconds
Exit code: 28 (CURLE_OPERATION_TIMEDOUT)
```

The curl-level timeout fails fast on network stalls while `INSTALL_COMMAND_TIMEOUT` (default 900 s) bounds the complete install pipeline. The sibling freshness path uses `run_installer_for_package_spec` which wraps the same curl in `timeout(1)`.
